checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan copy/paste for the multi-node selection using a detached prefab clipboard

impact_assessment.why: Multi-selection can transform and delete nodes but cannot copy/paste them, and duplicate only handles one node at a time.
impact_assessment.benefits: copy_selection captures top-level selected nodes as a detached clipboard prefab; paste_nodes instantiates fresh IDs under a chosen parent in one undo entry; console Copy/Paste controls.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 54 and two actions; dependency: Prefab capture/instantiate; concurrency: editor lock; state: empty selection/clipboard, nested selections, mixed parents, prefab-link rebasing, undo grouping.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse save_prefab_nodes folding and shared-parent validation, keep the clipboard detached, instantiate with fresh IDs, wrap paste in one history entry and add copy/paste/undo/error tests.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Multi-selection copy/paste implemented: copy_selection captures top-level selected nodes as a detached clipboard prefab with folding/shared-parent validation; paste_nodes instantiates fresh IDs under the selected node or explicit parent in one undo entry and selects the roots; clipboard report and console Copy/Paste controls; schema 54; 810 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, describe schema 54, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-copy-paste-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan keyframe authoring for library animation clips at the current timeline time

impact_assessment.why: The editor can preview, sample and save clips but cannot add or remove keyframes, so animation authoring stops at external JSON.
impact_assessment.benefits: set/remove_animation_key edit the selected node's position, rotation or scale track at a time and save the library clip; console channel/time controls and readout.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 55 and two actions; dependency: animation library/Track; concurrency: editor lock; state: no selection/library/name, invalid time/channel/value, duplicate keys, empty tracks, clip validation, asset writes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate through Track/AnimationClip, replace keys within epsilon, sort times, remove empty tracks, keep library writes atomic, and add set/replace/remove/error tests.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Animation keyframe authoring implemented: set_animation_key/remove_animation_key edit library .kanim clips for the selected node/channel/time, replacing keys within 1e-6, sorting times, dropping empty tracks, saving atomically and returning animation_key reports; console channel selector and Set/Remove key controls; schema 55; 811 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, describe schema 55, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-animation-keys-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan server-backed layer visibility toggles for the scene editor and viewer

impact_assessment.why: Scenes with many layers cannot hide unrelated nodes, and there is no AI-readable layer inventory or visibility state.
impact_assessment.benefits: The editor document exposes layer counts and hidden layers, set_layer_visible toggles them without scene edits, and the console/viewer filter hidden layers in render and picking.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 56 and one action; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: empty/unknown layer names, hidden selection, picking/pivot filtering, viewer resync.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate name/boolean, keep visibility session-only and neutral to history, render toggles from counts, filter render/picking/pivots, and add toggle/static tests.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Layer visibility implemented: editor document layers inventory (name,count) and session hidden_layers; set_layer_visible toggles without scene/history edits; viewer filters hidden layers from scene render, picking, marquee bounds and pivots while game view stays unclipped; console checkbox toggles; schema 56; 812 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, describe schema 56, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-layer-visibility-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan editor-only node locks with mutation protection and AI-readable lock state

impact_assessment.why: Large or prefab-heavy scenes can be accidentally transformed or deleted, and there is no lock state for authors or AI clients.
impact_assessment.benefits: Locked nodes and descendants reject transform/delete/reparent/asset/component/prefab edits while remaining selectable; nodes report locked and the document reports locked_ids/locked_count; console Lock/Unlock controls.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 57 and one action; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: inherited locks, batch actions, refresh_prefab_instances not lock-aware, session-only persistence.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Walk ancestors for effective locks, check mutation branches before history, keep locks session-only, add lock/unlock/error tests and document the remaining refresh gap.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Node locks implemented: session locked_ids plus set_nodes_locked; node documents expose locked flags and top-level locked_ids/locked_count; ancestor-aware checks block transforms, delete selection/node, reparent, asset assignment, component edits and prefab revert/apply; console Lock/Unlock controls and locked-count readout; schema 57; 813 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, describe schema 57, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-node-lock-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan named scene-view camera bookmarks persisted per game in localStorage

impact_assessment.why: The editor camera can be reset or focused, but recurring inspection views must be recreated manually every session.
impact_assessment.benefits: Save/apply/delete named camera snapshots with console controls and per-game storage; bookmarks restore target, distance, yaw and pitch.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI-only, no API/schema change; dependency: viewer camera state and localStorage; concurrency: none; state: malformed storage, missing camera, option preservation, game key changes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate snapshots in the viewer, guard localStorage parsing, key bookmarks by game, preserve selection, and add static regressions.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Camera view bookmarks implemented: viewer cameraBookmark/applyCameraBookmark with finite target/distance/yaw/pitch validation; console per-game localStorage bookmarks, sorted select, Save/Go/Delete controls and readout; no API/schema change; 813 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, describe schema 57, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-camera-bookmarks-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan cumulative commit audits from commit 1 (bff5072) through commit 3/6/9/12/15/18 and End

impact_assessment.why: The session added 18 feature commits without a cumulative review, so regressions and gaps may exist across interactions rather than inside single commits.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each cumulative range is inspected and tested; concrete fixes are committed and pushed after each pass, ending with a clean audited history.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: fixes touch editor reload, project manifests, core asset refresh and node documents; dependency: none new; concurrency: none; state: stale startup scenes, stale unchanged payloads, prefab dependency reload order, inherited lock UI, remote push.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Find and test one concrete issue per affected range, run targeted tests plus full AIKit gates, commit conventionally and push without force.
